title: Grama Devathe
desc: Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a moneylender. However, tables turn when she loses her property, and they fall in love.

title: Shwetha Nagara
desc: Madhumati ventures into the Nallamala Forest to procure an ancient book written by priests. Later, she encounters a shape-shifting snake that intends to kill her.

title: Hit
desc: A police officer struggling with a personal loss, has to put aside his feelings and concentrate on the probing of a girl who goes missing.

title: Daredevil Musthafa
desc: Ramanuja Iyengari and his gang are determined to get Musthafa expelled from their college. So, after a hilarious series of failed attempts, a riveting cricket match decides their fate.
